claims.claim: DeepSeek-R1 performs as well as OpenAI's o1 on certain AI benchmarks.
R1 beats o1 on the benchmarks AIME, MATH-500, and SWE-bench Verified.
Distilled versions of R1 range from 1.5 billion to 70 billion parameters, with the smallest able to run on a laptop.
The full R1 is available through DeepSeek's API at prices 90%-95% cheaper than OpenAI's o1.
R1 is available on Hugging Face under an MIT license, meaning it can be used commercially without restrictions.

delta: released open weights under MIT license
reported higher benchmark scores than o1 on AIME, MATH-500, SWE-bench Verified
offered API at significantly lower cost than OpenAI o1
parsed.tldr: DeepSeek released a 671B-parameter open reasoning model on Hugging Face with MIT license and cheaper API, but benchmark claims remain self-reported.
